scripts.deploy-staging: npx @google/clasp push && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const out = execSync('npx @google/clasp version').toString(); const ver = out.match(/\d+/)[0]; console.log('Deploying Version' + ver + '...'); execSync('npx @google/clasp deploy --deploymentId AKfycbwuH2J9dFnn7pKxUVYFm0_gy7HZPsdSHh_geKYcc7MY1suh7zD3ERHXi5Pw6IVENKY --versionNumber ' + ver + ' --description Version' + ver, { stdio: 'inherit' }); execSync('npx @google/clasp deployments', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Starting GitHub sync...'); execSync('git add .'); execSync('git commit -m \"Version ' + ver + '\"', { stdio: 'inherit' }); execSync('git push', { stdio: 'inherit' }); console.log('Successfully deployed and committed Version ' + ver + '!');"
